text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is something going on? Everyone's 
gathered in the hall...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Is it gonna rain soon? Is that why 
everyone's gathering!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Umm, wait! Today's training was supposed 
to be "Endurance Running," right...?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Oooh~! Thanks to the mud, our training 
efficiency is doubled~!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Lucky me!! I'm gonna go grab my rain suit 
right now!
